From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage accuracy check & pending price approvals — urgent forecast adjustments

Team,

Quick note as I pulled the May forecast: a handful of large deals are still sitting in "Commit" in the CRM but have unresolved pricing approvals (deal desk hold) or unreturned signature steps. If those deals don't clear pricing approval by COB Monday they should not be counted as committed in the weekly forecast refresh.

What I need from each of you by EOD today:
- Vanessa: list of deals currently marked "Commit" that have price exceptions pending (include HP/ACV and buyer contact).
- Karthik / Rishi: status on deal desk clearance for those exceptions; ETA to approve or formal rejection.
- Lauren: update any stage mis-tags so we can filter reliably for forecasting (i.e., move to "Best Effort" if approval outstanding).

I've flagged one high-risk deal below: Nimbus Energy (D-12486-NIM) — currently $1.2M ACV in CRM as Commit but procurement is pushing for an additional price concession. If we don't have signed approval from Deal Desk + DocuSign by Monday, reduce commit exposure to "Likely" in the forecast.

Thanks — I want to avoid an upside surprise to bookings if approvals aren't firm.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Kim — thanks for the heads up. List below (pulled from CRM at 09:45 PT):

1) Nimbus Energy — $1,200,000 ACV — procurement requested 10% concessional credit for term; DocuSign sent 5/13; hold pending deal desk price signoff. Buyer: Ellen Price (procurement).
2) Timberline Grid — $420,000 ACV — discount approved internally but price paperwork missing; legal loop needed. Buyer: Marcus Vale.
3) Skyward Labs — $95,000 ACV — signed SOW but finance flagged for invoicing cadence mismatch.

I'll move any deals where approvals are not documented to "Best Effort" tonight unless we get explicit clearance. Attaching the Nimbus quote (v3) we sent earlier.

- Vanessa

- Nimbus: Deal Desk can approve a one-time implementation credit up to 7% (documented). I am attaching the approval scan. Final approval requires: (1) updated quote in CRM reflecting the concession, (2) signed DocuSign matching the updated quote. - Timberline: needs legal clarification on SOW language; request remains open.

Thanks all — quick readout to close the loop:

- Karthik: thanks for the approval memo. Once Vanessa uploads the updated quote to the CRM and we have the DocuSign countersigned, treat Nimbus as an "Active Commit" for forecasting purposes. If DocuSign is not countersigned by Monday COB, move the $1.2M to "Likely" and reduce May committed bookings accordingly.
- Vanessa: please upload the amended quote and drop a short note in the HubSpot deal so Finance can reconcile.
- Rishi / Lauren: run the weekly forecast refresh with the adjusted commit flag (I will annotate the forecast sheet with the assumption).

I've also added the HubSpot link and DocuSign monitor to this thread so ops/finance have the artifacts. If there are any objections from Sales or Deal Desk, raise them now; otherwise proceed with the plan.

Kim
